privacy.title: Privacy & Data
privacy.subtitle: MindDiary is built with deep respect for your inner world. Here is how your reflections are protected.
privacy.encryptedDesc: Your journal entries, check-in notes, and CBT records are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption.
privacy.zeroTrackingDesc: We never sell your private reflections, profile your mood, or share data with advertising brokers.
privacy.deletableDesc: You own every word. Download a complete JSON archive anytime, or trigger immediate deletion.
privacy.whatStoredSubtitle: When you use MindDiary, we store the following data in your authenticated account:
privacy.ventBoxNote: Vent & Let Go Box: Anything you type in the Calm Space Vent and Let Go box is strictly in-memory in your browser. It is NEVER transmitted to the server or saved anywhere.
privacy.storeIntro: When you use MindDiary, we store the following data in your authenticated account:
privacy.storeCredsDesc: Your email address and securely hashed password (bcrypt).
privacy.storeJournalDesc: Entry dates, titles, tags, mood scores, and encrypted entry bodies.
privacy.storeWellnessDesc: Daily check-ins (sleep, energy, stress, mood), gratitude items, and habit logs.
privacy.storeCalmDesc: Completed breathing sessions, sound timers, and optional self-check scores (PHQ-9/GAD-7).
privacy.storeSafetyDesc: Optional trusted contact name & phone, your country preference for helplines, hashed app lock PIN, personal safety coping plan, and future letters.
privacy.ventBoxTipDesc: Anything you type in the Calm Space "Vent and Let Go" box is strictly in-memory in your browser. It is NEVER transmitted to the server or saved anywhere.
privacy.encryptionIntro: We protect your vulnerable text using AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption with a unique initialization vector (IV) and authentication tag for every single piece of content. In database storage, reflections appear prefixed with enc:v1:.
privacy.encryptedAtRestDesc: Diary entries, check-in notes, gratitude lists, AI chat messages, CBT thought records, coping plans, future letters, and storybooks.
privacy.notEncryptedDesc: Entry & letter titles, delivery dates, tags, mood labels (e.g. peaceful/happy), calendar dates, habit counts (water, sleep hours), and user preferences (theme, font, country).
privacy.hashedOneWayDesc: Account password (bcrypt), 4 to 6 digit App Lock PIN (bcrypt), password reset tokens (SHA-256), counselor share link tokens (SHA-256).
privacy.securityNote: Honest security note: Encryption at rest protects backups and database leaks. If the server runtime hosting the encryption key is compromised, encryption at rest cannot replace holistic server hardening.
privacy.aiUsageDesc: AI features are OFF by default and only run when you enable them. When enabled, selected text is sent to the Google Gemini API. Entries marked 'Hide from AI' are never sent. Features: Reflect/Mood Analysis (current entry text), Ask My Diary (question + top matching non-excluded excerpts), Storybooks (selected range/entries), Companion Chat (recent chat + optional today's check-in numbers), Thought Challenger & Writing Starters (prompt text). On the Gemini free tier, Google may use submitted content to improve products; on the paid tier (billing enabled), Google does not use submitted content for training.
privacy.onDemandOnlyDesc: AI is never called silently in the background. Only explicit user actions (such as clicking "Reflect with AI", "Check my mood", generating a storybook, or asking a question in "Ask My Diary") trigger an AI request.
privacy.askDiaryConsentTitle: Ask My Diary Separate Consent & Safe Retrieval:
privacy.askDiaryConsentDesc: Reading your diary requires a dedicated, separate consent toggle ("Allow Assistant to Read Diary"), which is OFF by default. When you ask a question, only matching excerpts (up to 500 characters around the best-matching sentence, top 6 entries maximum) are retrieved in memory and sent to Google Gemini. Excerpts are wrapped in explicit XML data delimiters and scanned locally for crisis indicators; any high-distress entries are dropped. Entries marked as excluded from AI are never read. Conversational context (last 6 messages) is stored encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM, any high-distress messages are omitted from future model context, and chat history can be erased instantly at any time via "Forget this chat".
privacy.providerNoTrainingDesc: MindDiary is for adults 18+ only (confirmed at sign-up). Free tier vs paid tier data handling follows Google's Gemini API Terms of Service.
privacy.mediaNoticeDesc: Uploaded images, videos, and voice recordings are hosted on Cloudinary inside a user-isolated folder. Media URLs are unguessable but not access-controlled. Uploaded media is permanently deleted from Cloudinary when you delete the entry or delete your account.
privacy.portabilityDesc: You have full data portability and the absolute right to be forgotten:
privacy.downloadAllDataDesc: Exports a clean, structured JSON archive containing every entry, habit, check-in, and self-check.
privacy.deleteAccountDataDesc: Permanently purges your account, all database records, and all uploaded media with password confirmation.
privacy.crisisPolicyDesc: MindDiary performs local on-save text scanning solely to protect you in times of distress. If high-concern signals are detected:
privacy.neverStoreKeywords: We NEVER store or log the matched distress keywords.
privacy.neverContactPolice: We NEVER automatically contact the police, emergency services, or family members.
privacy.compassionateAccess: We only offer you compassionate immediate access to verified helplines and your saved trusted contact.
